title: [TACZ] LR-Tactical TWEAK
description: Compatibility tweak for the original LesRaisins Tactical Equipments mod.
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/778e2b30b5d14535b98233dcbd1c4cc355a16340.png)

Compatibility tweak for the original LesRaisins Tactical Equipments mod.

LRTactical Tweak is a small Forge 1.20.1 mod that patches the original `lrtactical` mod at runtime with Mixins. ## Features - Stops repeated action sounds; with TACZ Tweaks, inspect sounds stay local and melee swings are shared as a vanilla sweep sound. - Improves the action progress bar and displays the TACZ crosshair while using LRTactical items. - Fixes cooked grenades not exploding when their fuse reaches zero in LRTactical 0.4.1. Install the mod on your client for the sound and HUD fixes. Multiplayer servers must also install it to apply the grenade fix and the TACZ Tweaks melee sound compatibility. ## Requirements - LesRaisins Tactical Equipments / `lrtactical` `0.3.0+` - Timeless and Classics Zero / `tacz` `1.1.7+` - Optional: TACZ Tweaks `2.13.2+` for Shared Gun Sounds compatibility ## Authors - Programmer: `Szo9K4` ## Credits - LesRaisins Tactical Equipments - Timeless and Classics Zero ## License - Code and assets: [GNU GPL 3.0](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
